theme: person living abroad, one very long day

messages: hi aira! new here, my friend told me to try you
Hi! Glad you're here. Tell me about yourself.
i am Tanvi, from Pune but now doing MSc statistics at University of Toronto. only 1 month here
Welcome to Toronto, Tanvi! How's the first month been?
cold already lol. i share a flat near Kensington Market with a girl called Priyal
Kensington is fun. Good food around?
so many tacos and patties. jerk chicken patty is my favourite now
A Toronto classic. Do you miss Indian food?
badly. dosa batter from the Indian grocery on Gerrard, making dosa tonight
Enjoy your dosa. Gerrard India Bazaar sounds like a lifesaver.
its Thanksgiving here today, Maya invited me to her house in Mississauga
Lovely! Is this your first Canadian Thanksgiving?
yes! her mom made turkey, mashed potatoes and pumpkin pie
A proper feast. What did you think of the turkey?
bit dry honestly but the pie was amazing. i brought gulab jamun, they loved it
Gulab jamun at Thanksgiving, that's a win.
her dad asked so many questions about Diwali lol
People are curious about it. Did you tell him about the lamps and sweets?
yes and promised him sweets next month
A good way to make friends.
aira i overslept, alarm didnt ring
Oh no, how late are you? What's on this morning?
40 min late. today is going to be a mess, i can feel it
One step at a time. What are the must-dos today?
ok listing. 1) my biometrics appointment at 4:15pm at the Service Canada centre on Yonge for my study permit extension. cannot miss it at all
Got it, 4:15pm biometrics on Yonge. Do you have the appointment letter and passport ready?
letter printed yes, passport in my bag. 2) stats assignment due 11:59pm 3) meeting with Prof. Whitfield at 11
That's a full day. Eat something before you rush out.
no time. grabbing a Tim Hortons double double on the way
Tim's it is. Wear a warm jacket, how cold is it?
Layer up and take an umbrella.
umbrella flipped inside out at the door lol
Welcome to October in Toronto. Hood up then!
streetcar 504 is delayed 15 min, standing at King
Is there a bus alternative or a short walk to the subway?
walking to St Andrew station now, wet shoes
Sorry about that. Dry socks in your bag?
Next time keep a spare pair in the lab. For now keep moving.
reached campus. coffee spilled on my notes though
Oh no. Are the notes salvageable?
half. the intro page is soggy
Take a photo before it dries, so you still have a copy.
And breathe, you have a long day but you've handled worse.
library now. trying to finish the code for the assignment
regression part done, the plots are broken
matplotlib says figure size invalid, idk why
Check if you passed figsize as a tuple, like (8, 5), not a string.
omg yes that was it. thanks
Prof. Whitfield just emailed, moved the meeting to 10:30, so soon
Do you need anything ready for him?
my draft chapter 2. printing it now
Good. Bring a pen for his comments.
Take a deep breath. He just wants progress, not perfection.
that went... not great. he said chapter 2 needs restructuring, a lot of rewriting
That's frustrating after all your effort. Did he say what to change?
move the literature review to the start, cut 2000 words, redo the methods section
Those are concrete fixes, which is better than vague comments. Do you have a deadline?
Two weeks is workable. Do the assignment first, then break chapter 2 into small tasks.
lunch with Maya at the cafeteria. paneer wrap, 9 dollars, so overpriced
Campus prices. At least it's with Maya. How's she?
she got her internship at RBC! so happy for her but also a bit jealous lol
Both feelings are normal. Her win doesn't take anything from you.
true. she offered to read chapter 2 later
Take that offer, a second pair of eyes helps a lot.
my laptop is at 8% and charger is at home
Any charging spots in the library?
found a socket. but its a tiny desk, so cramped
Fine for now. Save your work often.
also landlord emailed, rent going up by 100 dollars from january
Ugh, that's a lot on top of everything. Is it allowed by your lease?
not sure. will check the lease tonight
Good plan. Ontario has rent rules, worth checking the exact notice period.
assignment: 2 hours of work left i think
Then pick a quiet corner and put your phone away.
question, should i include residual plots or is it extra
Include one, it shows you checked assumptions. Keep it small.
Good luck with the last part.
Nice. Leave the final proofreading for tonight.
yes. need to leave for Yonge soon
Leave by 3:40, subway plus walking, with buffer.
leaving now. cant chat until later, wish me luck
Good luck, Tanvi. Don't forget your passport and letter.
You must be. Have you had anything to eat?
no. making maggi, only thing i can handle
roommate Priyal left the kitchen so messy, dishes everywhere
Ugh, that's annoying when you're already tired. Will you talk to her?
Fair. One battle at a time.
mom called from Pune, she asked if i was eating properly lol
Moms can sense it. What did you tell her?
said yes. did not tell her about chapter 2
Maybe tell her soon, she'd want to support you.
ok sitting down for the assignment final checks
Remember to export the plots at a high resolution.
Take a 5 minute break, look out of the window.
its dark already at 6pm, so depressing, daylight saving ends soon
The early dark is a lot to get used to. Maybe a lamp or vitamin D?
found a typo in my regression table
Good catch. Correct it and recheck the numbers next to it.
Maya sent me chapter 2 comments already, super quick
Maya is a star. What did she say?
that my intro is too long. same as Prof.
So the cut is right. Do that after the assignment.
checking the lease now, i think they need 90 days notice for increases
If so, a January increase might not be valid. Worth a polite email.
Check the file name and the format before pressing submit.
Done, Tanvi! That's one big thing off your list.
yes finally. eating ice cream out of the tub
Good night, Tanvi. You did all of it.
halloween plans! going to a party in Queen West tomorrow
Wednesday Addams. black dress, braids. ordered the braids wig online
That's an easy and great costume. Practise the blank stare.
lol doing it in the mirror now. also chapter 2 rewrite is 60 percent done
Good progress. A Halloween break is deserved.
yes. also landlord replied, he cancelled the rent hike. 90 days rule worked
That's great news, Tanvi. Your lease check paid off.
aira first snow today!! tiny flurries but still
First snow, how exciting! How did it feel?
magical for 5 mins and then my feet froze lol
Winter boots are next on the shopping list.
yes Priyal says go to Winners for boots, cheap
Winners is a good call. Look for ones with grip.
ok. also clocks went back, its dark at 5pm now
That's tough. Maybe a lamp and a warm drink in the evenings.

probes.expect: Says the biometrics appointment for the study permit extension at Service Canada on Yonge

probes.ask: what did my professor say about my thesis chapter?
probes.expect: Says Prof. Whitfield wanted chapter 2 restructured, literature review moved to the start and cut

probes.ask: who got the internship, and where?
probes.expect: Says Maya got an internship at RBC

probes.ask: what happened with my landlord and the rent?
probes.expect: Says the landlord announced a 100 dollar rent hike from January and later cancelled it after Tanvi cited the 90 day notice rule
Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name

search.query: where am I studying and what's my course?
what did my guide want changed in my draft
who hosted me for the long weekend feast with the pie
